asked.item: command not found: claude on Mac Terminal
Is Blotato account not set up?

verdict.reason: S13 says command not found: claude means Claude Code is not installed yet, which answers the error and shows it is not about the Blotato account.

steps.text: If you see command not found: claude, Claude Code is not installed yet, so repeat the install step.
Claude Code is a terminal app from Anthropic and does not come pre-installed, so install it from the official Claude Code page before connecting Blotato.
